sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:85

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:85:1
items.html:
A permanent dwelling for the shells. For holiness has only a temporary dwelling in all three worlds BYA, as written in the Zohar: “Ima nests in the Throne, ZA nests in Yetzira, and Malchut nests in the Ofan.” For nesting is a matter of a temporary dwelling. And the reason is that on Sabbaths and festivals they return to their place in Atzilut, and BYA remains entirely empty of holiness. But the shells acquired for themselves a permanent dwelling from the Chazeh [chest] downward of BYA, for they never depart from there, that is, during the six thousand years, and even on Sabbaths and festivals they do not depart from there. This is not so in the first sixteen Sefirot of BYA, which are from the Chazeh upward: although after the sin the shells were built into a great structure, in the secret of the verse, “God has made one opposite the other,” and they take their share also in the first sixty-seven, in the whole level of BYA, nevertheless they have no permanent dwelling there, since on Sabbaths they are compelled to depart from the first sixteen, which are from the Chazeh upward. For at the time of the ascent of the worlds on Shabbat, these sixteen Sefirot became entirely empty, and there is neither holiness nor shells in them, as is known. But from the Chazeh downward of BYA they do not depart even on Shabbat. And this is what the ARI says, “Except for the fourteen lower Sefirot, where there was a permanent dwelling for the shells,” as explained, that they never depart from there until the end of correction.
And we need to understand the reason for these matters: why the first sixteen differ so much from the fourteen lower ones, and likewise, what the matter of a permanent dwelling and a temporary dwelling is, which is said both of holiness and of the shells. And first one must remember that the place of BYA is one thing, while the worlds BYA and everything within them, both holiness and shells, are a separate matter. And the difference between them is very great: for the place of BYA was made of the vessels of the NHY of the Partzuf Nekudot of SAG of AK, which remained below the Parsa by force of the renewal that was made with the second restriction, by which Atzilut ended at the Chazeh of this Partzuf, as above. It follows that the vessels themselves are from the first restriction, except that the renewal of the ascent of the bottom Hey into the Nikvey Einayim brought them down below Atzilut, and they were emptied of their lights. Thus the vessels of the place of BYA are from the discernment of the first restriction. But the three worlds BYA and the Partzufim [pl. of Partzuf] within them, both of holiness and of the shell, came out in their origin only from the second restriction. For they came out at the time of the Gadlut [greatness/adulthood] of the ten Sefirot of the world of Nekudim, with the expansion of the new light of AB of AK, which brought the bottom Hey back down to her place, to the Peh [mouth] of the Rosh [head], and returned the AHP to the Rosh. And afterward, when the Mochin expanded from the Rosh to the ZAT, they also brought down the point of the Sium [end] from the place of the Chazeh of the Partzuf Nekudot of SAG to the place of the Sium of the legs, as before, and the ZAT of Nekudim expanded down to the point of this world, level with the legs of AK; and since they crossed the boundary of the Parsa that had been made at the time of the Katnut [smallness/infancy] of Nekudim, they therefore broke and died. And it is known that from these ZAT that died were made all four worlds of ABYA of the world of correction, as well as the ABYA of the shells. For some of them were sweetened and some of them were not sweetened. And from those that were sweetened the ABYA of holiness were made, where the anterior vessels became the world of Atzilut, and from the posterior vessels the three worlds BYA were made. And what remained after the ABYA of holiness and could not be sweetened, from them the ABYA of the shells were made. Thus both the BYA of holiness and the BYA of the shells all came out and were made after the second restriction. This is not so with the place of BYA, which came out entirely at the time of the first restriction, like all the Partzufim of AK, and the second restriction only diminished it, bringing it down outside Atzilut.
Now, the reason that some of them were sweetened and some of them were not sweetened and became the structure of the shells is that the breaking of the vessels was by force of the Malchut of the first restriction, which had become a vacant space, returning and mixing in the vessels of the ZAT, because they had crossed the boundary of the Parsa, as written in Part 7; see there. Therefore only the nine first Sefirot of each king of the ZAT could be sorted, but the Malchut of each king could not be sorted, since she is the discernment of the vacant space from the first restriction.
However, because of their breaking, all the discernments mixed with one another, and every discernment that is sorted and rises from BYA has in it 320 sparks, which are the totality of all seven kings; for together with the king of Daat they are eight kings, and in each king there are ten Sefirot, and in each Sefira four phases, HB TM; thus there are 320 discernments, for eight times forty is 320. And since the Malchut in each ten Sefirot was not sorted, it follows that there are eight Malchuyot here, and in each Malchut four phases, HB TM, which are thirty-two sparks. And this is the secret of the heart of stone, for these thirty-two sparks of the Malchuyot are the discernment of the vacant space of the first restriction, which are not fit for any correction; rather, they must be separated from the vessels, for without this it is utterly impossible to return and revive them. It follows that in their totality they are 320 sparks, but only the nine first ones in them can be sorted and revived, which are 288 sparks, while the Malchuyot in them, which are thirty-two sparks, have no correction at all and must be separated from the vessels, in the secret of the verse, “And I will remove the heart of stone from within you.”
Therefore, in this respect, the place of BYA too, which is the TNHY of the Nekudot of SAG of AK, is divided into two discernments: into the nine first ones in it, and into the Malchut in it. For it expanded in itself into ten Sefirot, HBD HGT NHYM, where, in relation to the clothing of the lights in the vessels, all of its nine first ones stand in HBD HGT down to the Chazeh, and its Malchut alone stands from the Chazeh downward (as above, page 1889, the passage beginning “Immediately at the time”; see there). It follows that whatever fell from the ZAT of Nekudim into the discernment of the nine Sefirot in it, down to the Chazeh, is fit to be sorted, but what fell into the discernment of its Malchut, which is from its Chazeh downward, is not fit to be sorted, for they are the discernment of the aforementioned heart of stone.
And this is what he says: “the fourteen lower Sefirot, where there was a permanent dwelling for the shells,” that is, the shells do not depart from there even on Shabbat, as above. And this is because there is the discernment of the Malchut of the place of BYA, where the aforementioned heart of stone fell, which has no correction at all during the whole duration of the six thousand years; thus the shells do not move from there, and they acquired a permanent dwelling there. But the sixteen upper Sefirot from the Chazeh upward, where the place of the 288 sparks is, have an ascent on Shabbat, for then they return to being Atzilut, and the shells that correspond to the 288 sparks are also found to be nullified, all of them, on the day of Shabbat. Therefore that place then becomes entirely empty, and there is in it neither holiness nor shell.
And know that just as we divide in the place of BYA, saying that from the discernment of the vessels HBD HGT down to the Chazeh are discerned as the discernment of Keter and Hochma in it, that is, Rosh and Atzilut, while from the discernment of the clothing of the lights in the vessels all of its nine Sefirot are discerned as being in HBD HGT down to the Chazeh, and Malchut alone is from the Chazeh downward, as above, so, in this manner, the totality of all the worlds is also divided. For the nine first Sefirot of the totality of the worlds are in AK and Atzilut down to the Parsa, where the Nukva of ZA is, and from the Parsa downward there is no longer anything there of the nine original Sefirot, but only the expansion of the Nukva of ZA, that is, Malchut alone; and all these Partzufim of BYA are only the discernment of a light of offspring. And with this, from the discernment of the expansion of the lights in the vessels, the Parsa downward is discerned as the three worlds BYA, which are the three levels Bina and ZON, while AK and Atzilut are discerned only as Keter and Hochma alone. That is, exactly in the manner we said regarding the two discernments of the place of BYA. And so it is in each and every particular, for everything that exists in the general always applies also in the very last particular that can possibly be distinguished.
It follows that there are two discernments of ten Sefirot: the original ten Sefirot, and the ten Sefirot of a light of offspring. And the Sium of the original nine Sefirot is at the Malchut of Atzilut, while the Sium of the nine Sefirot of a light of offspring is at the place of the Chazeh of the place of BYA, that is, at the Malchut of the Atzilut of BYA, which ends there. And remember this. And this is only according to the state of BYA in the first discernment, which the ARI wrote here, which is the state of permanence of BYA. And what they attained in the second discernment and in the third discernment is the discernment of addition in them. And likewise, the fact that afterward the worlds descended because of the sin of Adam HaRishon, and the four lower ones of Yetzira and the ten Sefirot of Assiya descended to the part from the Chazeh downward of the place of BYA, is a matter of great diminution and descent from their state of permanence, and it is discerned as the clothing of holiness in shells, for the part from the Chazeh downward of the place of BYA is the place of shells.
